title: Sync Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev sync --json` (and `qdev sync --rebuild --json`): the counts from one hydration pass. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

parsed.description: Files re-parsed and upserted this pass.

unchanged.description: Scanned files whose content hash was unchanged, so they were not re-parsed.

purged.description: Removed files whose cache rows were purged this pass.

findings.description: Total finding rows remaining in the cache after this pass.
